title: Procurement and Contract Management by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade for its Security Enhancement Program
entity: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
summary: The objective of the audit was to determine whether DFAT effectively conducted procurements for the Security Enhancement Program, achieving value for money and complying with the Commonwealth Procurement Rules.
excerpt: What did we find? Procurements conducted by DFAT for the SEP were partly effective in achieving value for money and partly complied with the Commonwealth Procurement Rules. Contract management by the department was partly appropriate. What did we recommend? There were six recommendations to DFAT. DFAT agreed to all six recommendations. Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade response: Agreed.
